company.shortDescription: Electronic Arts is a software publishing company that delivers games and online services for consoles, PCs, mobile phones, and tablets.
company.description: Electronic Arts develops and publishes interactive entertainment software for consoles, personal computers, and mobile devices. The company creates games and services across genres like sports, action, and simulation under franchises such as Madden NFL and The Sims. Electronic Arts also operates digital distribution platforms and offers subscription gaming services.

aiResearchSummary.text: Electronic Arts is researching systems for video game replay editing and cinematic replay, interactive gameplay playback, and videographer and spectator modes in online games. It develops route generation systems within virtual sports environments, goal driven animation and character controllers using motion variational autoencoders, and style-controlled generation of visual assets for video games using machine learning. Work also covers state stream game engines for decoupled simulation and rendering in game applications. These efforts span gameplay capture, animation, content generation and engine architecture.
